constants.name: alpha
constants.why: Q-learning learning rate, shared by all systems (method/run.py --alpha)

constants.name: gamma
constants.why: discount factor, shared by all systems (method/run.py --gamma)

constants.name: epsilon
constants.why: epsilon of the epsilon-greedy action selection, shared by all systems (method/run.py --eps)

constants.name: beta
constants.why: bonus scale beta at its default; also the per-step penalty beta*offset (run setting beta)

constants.name: beta_sweep_low
constants.why: smallest bonus scale in the beta sweep (run setting, group sweep_beta)

constants.name: beta_sweep_mid
constants.why: bonus scale 0.3 in the beta sweep (run setting, group sweep_beta)

constants.name: predictor_lr
constants.why: Adam learning rate of the RND predictor (method/run.py, class RND, lr=3e-3)

constants.name: normaliser_eps
constants.why: epsilon added to the running std in the RND normaliser e/(sd + 1e-8) (method/run.py)

constants.name: spike_threshold
constants.why: threshold on the early raw bonus above which a run is counted as a spike run (method/make_tables.py, SPIKE = 1e4); an analysis setting, chosen after seeing the gap

constants.name: early_window_steps
constants.why: number of first steps over which the diagnostic bonus_max_early is taken (method/run.py)

constants.name: pilot_seed
constants.why: seed of the pilot runs, outside the evaluation seeds 0-4 (group pilot)

constants.name: budget_chain_steps
constants.why: step budget of the chain tasks; steps_to_first_reward is censored at it (method/run.py)

constants.name: budget_room_steps
constants.why: step budget of the room tasks; steps_to_first_reward is censored at it (method/run.py)

constants.name: final_return_window_pct
constants.why: final return is the mean return over the last 20 percent of training episodes (method/run.py, n_last = episodes // 5)

constants.name: significance_level
constants.why: conventional significance level the p-values are compared against (research.yaml ambition.alpha)

constants.name: room6_cells
constants.why: number of non-wall cells of the largest task room_6 (35 x 5 grid minus 5 walls of 4 cells), computed by method/run.py Env
